newsitem.title: USA: Fed seen adding reserves through customer RPs.
newsitem.headline: Fed seen adding reserves through customer RPs.

text.p: The Federal Reserve is expected to add temporary reserves to the banking system on Tuesday via customer repurchase agreements, analysts said.
"We're expecting the Fed to add via customer RPs," said an economist at Stone and McCarthy Research Associates Inc.
However, analysts did not discount the possibility of a more agreesive move by the Fed. MMS International Inc. expects the central bank to add via term system repurchase agreements.
At 1030 EST/1530 GMT, federal funds were changing hands at 5-5/16 percent, above the Fed's 5-1/4 percent target.
